mainEntity.name: My AI follow-up emails get no replies—what should I fix first?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A weak result does not automatically mean AI failed; the problem may be the offer, audience, trigger, timing, list quality, call to action, or tracking. Diagnose the entire workflow before rewriting every email.

Context: Run My AI Biz’s business education connects research, offer positioning, funnel structure, sales copy, and follow-up rather than treating email as an isolated task. Its examples support testing assumptions before expanding a system.

Key factors:
- Whether the message reaches the right people.
- Whether the initial promise matches the follow-up.
- Whether each email adds a useful reason to respond.
- Whether technical events and conversions are recorded correctly.

Practical guidance: Review one stage at a time: trigger, audience, offer, content, timing, delivery, and action path. Compare replies and negative signals before changing tone or adding more messages.

Run My AI Biz can help owners use AI for structured diagnosis instead of endless copy variations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check the audience, trigger, offer, deliverability, timing, call to action, and tracking before rewriting everything. Confirm that the follow-up matches the original promise and adds new value. Review replies, bounces, unsubscribes, and complaints, then change one major factor at a time.
